name: Heather Davis
tagline: Top rated Employment & Labor attorney in El Segundo, California
education: University of Denver Sturm College of Law
about: Attorney Heather Davis is a partner with Protection Law Group, LLP, in El Segundo, California. A highly rated trial lawyer with more than 21 years of total legal experience, Ms. Davis focuses her practice primarily on employment law litigation, and she provides invaluable counsel and support to clients throughout Los Angeles and Orange counties and the surrounding areas of Southern California who suffered a serious violation of their rights as workers on the job.

Over the course of her practice, Ms. Davis has achieved considerable success advocating on behalf of those who experienced workplace discrimination, sexual harassments, wrongful termination, employer retaliation, wage and hour issues, and other serious work-related grievances. She has extensive experience handling class actions on behalf of employees across her region, and she has recovered millions of dollars in total compensation for her plaintiff clients.

Honored for her outstanding professionalism and unwavering dedication to those she serves, Ms. Davis has earned consistent top rankings and endorsements from her peers. She has also received many top reviews from her clients along with numerous testimonials and referrals from those she has served.

A 1995 graduate of the University of Arizona, Ms. Davis obtained her Juris Doctor from the University of Denver Sturm College of Law in 1995. She holds her license to practice in Colorado, Arizona and California, and she is admitted to practice before all U.S. District Courts in California as well as the District of Colorado, the District of Minnesota and the Northern District of Texas. She also practices before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 9th and 10th Circuits.

Regarded as a leader in her field, Ms. Davis helped to develop laws that govern how claims are handled under the Private Attorney General Act, and she is an active member of the Consumer Attorneys Association of Los Angeles, the California Employment Lawyers Association, the South Bay Bar Association and the Labor and Employment Section of the Los Angeles County Bar Association.
